title: Palak Puri
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: -Himalayan pink salt ½ tsp or to taste
steps.romanUrdu: -Himalayan pink salt ½ tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: -In blender jug,add spinach,garlic,ginger,green chillies,fresh coriander,water,blend well & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: -Blender jug mein palak,lehsa,adrak,hari mirchein,hara dhania aur pani dal ker ache tarhan blend ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: -In a bowl,add all-purpose flour,cumin seeds,nigella seeds,pink salt,red chilli crushed,carom seeds & mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: -Bowl mein maida,zeera,kalonji,pink salt,lal mirch crushed aur ajwain dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.
-Cooking oil dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Gradually add blended green mixture & knead until dough is formed,cover & let it rest for 15 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: -Thora thora ker ka blended green mixture shamil karein aur ghond ker dough tayyar ker lein aur dhak ker 15 minutes kliya chor dein.

steps.instruction: -Sprinkle dry flour,knead & stretch until smooth dough is formed.
steps.romanUrdu: -Maida chirak dein aur dough ko stretch ker ka smooth dough tayyar ker lein.

steps.instruction: -With the help of greased hand,take a small dough (50g) & make a ball.
steps.romanUrdu: -Greased hand ki madad sa chota dough (50g) lein aur ball bana lein.

steps.instruction: -Add cooking oil & spread the dough with the help of hand.
steps.romanUrdu: -Cooking oil dal dein aur haath ki madad sa dough ko pheela lein.

steps.instruction: -In a wok,heat cooking oil & fry on medium flame until it puffs up & light golden (makes 10-12).
steps.romanUrdu: -Karahi mein cooking oil garam karein aur darmiyani ancch per light golden ho janay tak fry ker lein (makes 10-12).

ogDescription: When you make Blended Palak juice to make puri dough you get an amazing taste upgraded palak puri. Do give it a try this ramadan. #happycookingtoyou
